_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to come apart at the bottom (design 5.3). The dearest
thing in the price list and the only one that ends the Age: fissures open at the world floor,
widen, and put whatever falls in back in the overworld. Each step bought is how fast the tear
spreads. Priced so that only an Age written to be unsalvageable can reach it: the budget is spent
cheapest-first and each register is filled before the next is touched, so the first step of this one
wants an index of 188 with the prices as they now stand. `/age decay <name> unstable <n>` is how that
is reached for testing -- earning it honestly wants a book of two dozen pages opposing two dozen
